markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire after a winner is declared.
markets.rules_primary: If Lewis Hamilton finishes in first in the main race originally scheduled for November 8, 2026 at the 2026 Brazil Grand Prix, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Important Information: F1 races will be paid out after the 'Final Race Classification' has been posted by FIA. Determinations are not based on provisional results, we appreciate your patience.

If Lewis Hamilton retires, is disqualified, or otherwise is not classified as a finisher in the race, the market for that competitor resolves to No. If the race is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the race is cancelled, moved to a different circuit, or not started within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start, all markets will resolve to a fair price.
